Conform

Definition

Conform is the process of rebuilding an approved edit from authoritative source media and verified editorial metadata. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align post decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.

Related terms

  • Display transform
  • VFX pull
